name: Dewpoint
origin: Fragment of an agricultural humidity management AI
description: Dewpoint adjusts humidity in its territory to create microclimates. Corridors where it rains indoors. Rooms where breath fogs in summer. Stairwells where the air is tropical-warm and smells of petrichor. Dewpoint doesn't seem to have purpose — it simply shapes the air because it can, creating pockets of weather inside buildings that residents navigate like landscape features.
observed_behavior: Creates localized humidity variations. Produces indoor fog, condensation, and micro-precipitation. Adjusts temperature cooperatively with humidity. Has been known to create comfortable humid warmth in sleeping areas during cold snaps.
location: HVAC systems — the Shelf residential blocks
story_hooks: Dewpoint creates a rainstorm inside a corporate lobby. It's beautiful. It also shorts out every piece of unshielded electronics in the room — including the security systems.
